title: Summarize the README
task: Read README.md in this repo and give me a three-bullet summary of what the project does.

tools.result: # Orbit — a tiny CLI that syncs dotfiles across machines via a git remote. Commands: init, push, pull, status.

script.answer:
- Orbit is a small CLI that keeps your dotfiles in sync across machines.
- It stores them in a git remote you own.
- Four commands cover the workflow: init, push, pull and status.
